words.def: an opinion you give someone about what they should do
to make a choice after thinking about the possibilities
the sad feeling you have when something is worse than you hoped
a good effect or an advantage that something brings
to provide someone or something with the things they need
belonging to, or about, one particular person
the worried, tense feeling caused by having too much to deal with
using computer technology rather than paper or moving parts
a phrase for putting a thing into a general group when you cannot name it
a phrase for explaining what a thing does
a phrase for defining an object by what it does
the question you ask when you cannot remember the name of something

words.en: Do you know what I mean?
words.def: the question you ask to check that the other person is following you
the opening line of a formal complaint email
the sentence you use to ask a company for your money back

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
It’s a kind of machine.

Start with the group it belongs to: a kind of machine / tool / container. This alone gets you halfway.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
You use it to record things. — It’s used for recording things.

Two ways to say what it does. use it to + verb, but used for + -ing.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
It’s a thing which you put into the wall.

which or that introduces what the object does. Both are correct here.

steps.title: Which two say exactly the same thing in different words?
options: a kind of and a thing which
use it to + verb and used for + -ing
steps.answer: use it to + verb and used for + -ing

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: describe a thing whose name you have forgotten — It’s a kind of…
say what something is for — It’s used for opening… / You use it to open…
compare it with something known — It looks like… It’s made of…
keep the conversation going — What’s it called? Do you know what I mean?
open and close a formal complaint — I am writing to complain about… I look forward to your reply
ask for your money back — I would like a full refund
